readings: Among driverStandings entries with season-to-date points greater than 1, what is the average season-to-date win count, excluding entries with missing win counts? Do not round.
Among driverStandings entries with season-to-date points greater than or equal to 1, what is the average season-to-date win count, excluding entries with missing win counts? Do not round.
queries:
SELECT AVG(wins)
FROM driverStandings
WHERE points > 1
  AND wins IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(wins)
FROM driverStandings
WHERE points >= 1
  AND wins IS NOT NULL
